root_cause: The Instagram delivery contract proved technical media validity and Mira-style identity metadata, but did not require an explicit Mira content persona nor visible-Mira proof as a distinct semantic condition. As a result, generic Bedrijfsgeheugen creative could satisfy transport-oriented checks and reach the Instagram company channel.
prevention_rule: Instagram is a Mira-only channel. Every Instagram artifact must explicitly declare contentPersona=mira and contentClass=mira_daily_life, the exact final asset must prove miraPresent=true, and generic Bedrijfsgeheugen brand creative must be blocked. Missing or contradictory identity evidence fails closed before scheduling or publishing.

evidence.incident: A generic Bedrijfsgeheugen Instagram creative was published on the Instagram account even though the intended channel persona is Mira.
evidence.symptom: Instagram showed a Bedrijfsgeheugen quote/brand post instead of Mira daily-life content.
evidence.terminal_rule: No LIVE or DONE claim until protected merge and main/readback evidence prove the exact gate is present.
